ops.text: The f1bf7be stall rewrite changed the fake's `get` from `[ -f marker ] && printf ...` (exit 1 when absent) to `if [ -f marker ]; then ...; fi`, which falls through with exit 0 and empty stdout when the service is absent. start_services treated every service as existing and skipped the create; the gate's json.loads("") then never saw running, so the success fixtures polled to the 30 s deadline. Confirmed by ready-gate-lane by running the fake under plain sh (missing -> exit 0 before the fix, exit 1 after).
